description: Central Province Provincial Council - Establishment of Waste Management Authority, No. 04 of 2017 of the Central Province
reasoning: The gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (Solid Waste Management Authority Statute No. 04 of 2017) that establishes a regulatory framework for waste management. It creates a legal entity, outlines its composition, powers, and operational procedures, and repeals previous provisions. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the creation of new legislation and regulatory structures, not government personnel changes or organizational restructuring without specific legislation.
